premises.text: Regular screening is necessary to prevent serious eye diseases.
premises.evidence_span: the only way to achieve it is to do regular screening.

premises.text: Diabetic patients are at high risk of eye complications without regular screening.
premises.evidence_span: the biggest risk group is the diabetic patients.

premises.text: There is a growing number of diabetic patients requiring eye care.
premises.evidence_span: only 15 years ago, only in the Netherlands, there were 400,000 diabetic patients. Today, this number is tripled.

premises.text: An AI assistant can help doctors diagnose eye diseases quickly and accurately.
premises.evidence_span: we've built our artificial intelligence assistant that can help doctors to make a diagnosis just in a couple of seconds.

premises.text: The AI solution can achieve higher accuracy than human doctors.
Optician chains and telemedicine companies are potential customers for the AI solution.
premises.evidence_span: We see our first customers as optician chains, general practitioners, and telemedicine companies.

premises.text: The subscription model for the AI service is cost-effective compared to traditional screening.
premises.evidence_span: starting with only 5 euros per image, comparing to the lowest price on Dutch market today is 25 euros per screening.

premises.text: There are few competitors in the AI ophthalmology market.
premises.evidence_span: Artificial intelligence in ophthalmology is a brand new field, and that's why we've got very few competitors in the world.

premises.text: The collaboration with iClinic Rotterdam will help validate the AI solution.
premises.evidence_span: we've signed papers with iClinic Rotterdam, which is the biggest and best eye hospital in the Netherlands.

premises.text: The project aims to collect and annotate a large dataset for glaucoma screening.
premises.evidence_span: we're going to collect and annotate, together with them, more than 100,000 special eye images for glaucoma screening.

premises.text: The AI solution has the potential to expand into other areas of healthcare.
premises.evidence_span: it gives us opportunity to discover cardiovascular diseases and neurological diseases also.

value.text: AI can improve the speed and accuracy of eye disease diagnosis.
value.evidence_span: you receive your diagnosis within one minute.
